title: Shrek 2 (PC, 2004)
notes: game.exe is the application body (UE2 Launch.cpp plus the exe's own native classes).
The engine itself lives in Core.dll (0x10100000) and Engine.dll (0x10300000);
Shrek 2's native game classes are in KWGame.dll (0x10000000). Those stay real
machine code (hybrid recompilation); only game.exe is lifted.
The exe imports C++ methods by decorated name from the UE2 DLLs, so the lift
must bind against the shipping DLLs from the same install folder.
